ventures.notes: Class A and Class B share equally in dividends and liquidation; Class B carries 10 votes and elects 51% of the board. No preferred or Class C shares are outstanding after the June 2026 IPO (the 10-Q reports none). The Class B cover count appears to include restricted Class B shares issued to Musk under performance awards (the prospectus footnote counts 1,302,072,285 restricted Class B shares held of record by him). The stake is the prospectus table as adjusted for the IPO: 849,494,440 Class A (11.3% of the class) and 5,569,053,075 Class B (93.6% of the class, including 350,000,000 Class B shares underlying options exercisable within 60 days), 84.4% of combined voting power. The prospectus cover gives 82.4% on a different basis; the table figure is used. No proxy has been filed since the IPO, and Musk's June 17, 2026 Form 4 reports holdings consistent with the table. The prospectus gives no economic percentage, so pctEconomic is null.

source.label: SpaceX IPO prospectus (Form 424B4, June 12, 2026), Management (Elon Musk biography)
source.quote: Mr. Musk co-founded PayPal, an electronic payment system, which was acquired by eBay in October 2002, and Zip2 Corporation, a provider of Internet enterprise software and services, which was acquired by Compaq in March 1999.

notes: Tesla, the primary company, stays in research/lenses/marketcap. SpaceX listed on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas in June 2026 (Class A only, symbol SPCX). It absorbed xAI, and with it X (formerly Twitter), on February 2, 2026, so X is counted inside SpaceX and not separately. The prospectus biography also names Zip2 Corporation, which he co-founded and which Compaq acquired in March 1999. Apart from Tesla and PayPal (already on the list), no other company in that biography is listed today. The founder wording for Neuralink and The Boring Company comes from SpaceX's prospectus, not from either company's own filing; both are private. The years are the incorporation years in each company's own Form D: Neuralink Corp. (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1708503/000170850317000001/xslFormDX01/primary_doc.xml, "Within Last Five Years (Specify Year) 2016") and TBC - The Boring Co (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1737630/000173763018000001/xslFormDX01/primary_doc.xml, "Within Last Five Years (Specify Year) 2017"). The prospectus gives no year for PayPal, so its year is null. Musk’s economic share of SpaceX is derived from the prospectus table (shares he owns outright ÷ all shares outstanding), because the prospectus states only class and voting percentages.
